issues.on_page: Line 27 Investments, General Fund 2,919.06 (already inside line 28 subtotal / ending balance 9,775.01)
issues.issue: beginning_investments (2,859.75) and ending_investments (2,919.06) are already inside beginning_cash (57,580.80, line 3) and ending_cash (60,542.29, line 24/28), so anything that adds cash and investments counts them twice. The budget-form rule leaves the investment fields null in this situation. The notes say they are 'informational', but the fields themselves do not say so.
